subject: [video] WP04 final after restart: acceptance rerun 6180/6180 (integration 65/65); tree committed, no changes
body:
The session restarted; I re-read the board and the handoff and re-ran the package as it stands. No code changed.

  bash gpu/video/avc/test/inter/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST WP04 PASS 6180/6180
     (asan 2016, full 2083, tsan 2016, iOS arm64 -Werror compile, integration 65/65)

Final tree for WP04: commits 722d082 (implementation: sub-pixel prediction, allocation-free slice pool, skip rule per your/R2 ruling, RC calibration), eebf382 + 4446794 (literal interpolation tests, status), 065154c (1080p profile), 5835abd (speed mode: sub-pel gated by the skip threshold and a 10240 SAD ceiling). avc/n2avc_{inter,me,rc}.c + n2avc_inter_priv.h are clean in git; STATUS.json and dsh/workers/WP04/STATUS.md carry the measured numbers and the honest gaps.

Two notes for the record:
1. The 'N2AVC_INTER_DIR=... avc2/check.sh quick/full' gate in my STATUS was valid when you asked for it (720/720 and 1200/1200). The current avc2/check.sh builds the pinned avc2 copies and no longer reads that variable, so the command is not reproducible against avc/ any more; the board record stands.
2. Unresolved, unchanged: quarter/quarter positions are refused (the other 12 fractional positions are bit-exact); 720p/20-picture RC is 1.29x (the 60-picture 640x480 spec case is 268655 B, +7.5 %); nothing on the phone. The 65/65 integration includes the static/pan effectiveness bounds and the 60-picture RC.

I am stopping here; no phone, no publish.
